CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f_gap_fill_update(tbl text, id text, row_num text)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS
$func$
DECLARE
   _set  text;
   _sel  text;
BEGIN
   SELECT string_agg(format('%1$I = u.%1$I', c.column_name), ', ' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position)
        , string_agg(format('gap_fill(%1$I) OVER w AS %1$I', c.column_name), ', ' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position)
   INTO   _set, _sel
   FROM   information_schema.columns c
   WHERE  c.table_schema = current_schema()
   AND    c.table_name   = tbl
   AND    c.is_nullable  = 'YES'
   AND    c.column_name NOT IN (id, row_num);

   IF _set IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'No nullable columns found in table %', tbl;
   END IF;

   EXECUTE format(
      'UPDATE %1$I t SET %2$s
       FROM (SELECT ctid AS row_ctid, %3$s
             FROM %1$I
             WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY %4$I ORDER BY %5$I)) u

WITH buys AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, date, molecules, usd_total,
         SUM(molecules) OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY date, transaction_id) - molecules AS start_qty,
         SUM(molecules) OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY date, transaction_id) AS end_qty
  FROM transaction
  WHERE NOT sell
), sells AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, date, molecules, usd_total,
         SUM(molecules) OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY date, transaction_id) - molecules AS start_qty,
         SUM(molecules) OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id ORDER BY date, transaction_id) AS end_qty
  FROM transaction
  WHERE sell
)
SELECT b.molecule_id,
       b.date AS buy_date,
       s.date AS sell_date,
       LEAST(b.end_qty, s.end_qty) - GREATEST(b.start_qty, s.start_qty) AS molecules,
       ROUND(b.usd_total * (LEAST(b.end_qty, s.end_qty) - GREATEST(b.start_qty, s.start_qty)) / b.molecules, 2) AS buy_usd_total,
       ROUND(s.usd_total * (LEAST(b.end_qty, s.end_qty) - GREATEST(b.start_qty, s.start_qty)) / s.molecules, 2) AS sell_usd_total
FROM buys b
JOIN sells s
  ON b.molecule_id = s.molecule_id
 AND b.start_qty < s.end_qty
 AND s.start_qty < b.end_qty
ORDER BY b.date, s.date;

      FROM tbl t

WITH RECURSIVE "my_table" AS
  (SELECT 'A' AS "cto", 1 AS "nif", 'A1' AS "file_", 5 AS "filesize"
   UNION ALL SELECT 'A', 1, 'A2', 3
   UNION ALL SELECT 'A', 2, 'A3', 2
   UNION ALL SELECT 'A', 2, 'A4', 1
   UNION ALL SELECT 'B', 1, 'B1', 4
   UNION ALL SELECT 'B', 1, 'B2', 6),
numbered AS
  (SELECT t.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cto"
                             ORDER BY SUBSTR("file_", 1, 1), CAST(SUBSTR("file_", 2) AS INTEGER)) AS "rn"
   FROM "my_table" t),
flagged AS
  (SELECT n.*,
          CASE WHEN LAG("nif") OVER (PARTITION BY "cto" ORDER BY "rn") = "nif" THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "new_blk"
   FROM numbered n),
blocked AS
  (SELECT f.*, SUM("new_blk") OVER (PARTITION BY "cto" ORDER BY "rn") AS "bn"
   FROM flagged f),
blocks AS
  (SELECT "cto", "bn", SUM("filesize") AS "blk_size"
   FROM blocked GROUP BY "cto", "bn"),
bins AS
  (SELECT "cto", "bn", "blk_size" AS "cum_size", 1 AS "mn"
   FROM blocks WHERE "bn" = 1
   UNION ALL
   SELECT b."cto", b."bn",
          CASE WHEN r."cum_size" + b."blk_size" > 10 THEN b."blk_size" ELSE r."cum_size" + b."blk_size" END,
          CASE WHEN r."cum_size" + b."blk_size" > 10 THEN r."mn" + 1 ELSE r."mn" END
   FROM bins r
   JOIN blocks b ON b."cto" = r."cto" AND b."bn" = r."bn" + 1)
SELECT x."cto",
       x."nif",
       x."file_",
       (bi."mn" - 1) / 7 + 1 AS "partition",
       (bi."mn" - 1) % 7 + 1 AS "subpartition",
       SUM(x."filesize") OVER (PARTITION BY x."cto", bi."mn") AS "total_size"
FROM blocked x
JOIN bins bi ON bi."cto" = x."cto" AND bi."bn" = x."bn"
ORDER BY x."cto", x."rn";

    SELECT start_date, end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT end_date + 1 AS start_date,
               LEAD(start_date - 1, 1, '9999-01-01'::date) OVER (ORDER BY start_date) AS end_date
        FROM merge_table_2

        UNION ALL

        SELECT '1900-01-01'::date AS start_date,
               MIN(start_date) - 1 AS end_date
        FROM merge_table_2
    ) k
    WHERE start_date <= end_date
      AND '1900-01-01'::date <= start_date
      AND end_date <= '9999-01-01'::date

  SELECT e.exp_id, e.mid, e.qty,
         CASE WHEN e.qty <= i.qty THEN i.qty - e.qty ELSE i.qty END AS QtyAvailable,
         CASE WHEN e.qty <= i.qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Executable,
         e.ExpRN
  FROM ExpCTE e
  INNER JOIN Inventory i ON i.mid = e.mid
  WHERE e.ExpRN = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.exp_id, e.mid, e.qty,
         CASE WHEN e.qty <= c.QtyAvailable THEN c.QtyAvailable - e.qty ELSE c.QtyAvailable END,
         CASE WHEN e.qty <= c.QtyAvailable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         e.ExpRN
  FROM ExpCTE e
  INNER JOIN CTE c ON c.ExpRN + 1 = e.ExpRN AND c.mid = e.mid
)
SELECT exp_id, mid, Executable
FROM CTE
ORDER BY exp_id;

WITH RECURSIVE vt as (
select t.*, row_number() over (partition by CustomerID order by StartDate) as seqnum
from transactions_1k t
),
cte as (
select vt.TransactionID, vt.CustomerID, vt.StartDate, vt.EndDate, vt.EndDate as ref_end_date, 0 as flag, seqnum
from vt
where seqnum = 1
union all
select vt.TransactionID, vt.CustomerID, vt.StartDate, vt.EndDate,
(case when vt.StartDate > (cte.ref_end_date + interval '90 days') then vt.EndDate else cte.ref_end_date end),
(case when vt.StartDate > (cte.ref_end_date + interval '90 days') then 0 else 1 end),
vt.seqnum
from cte join
vt
on vt.seqnum = cte.seqnum + 1 and vt.CustomerID = cte.CustomerID
)
select cte.TransactionID, cte.CustomerID, cte.StartDate, cte.EndDate, cte.flag
from cte
order by cte.CustomerID, cte.StartDate;
